How can the Taskflow account be created

To create a TaskFlow account, open the TaskFlow sign-up page and enter your name, work email address, and a secure password. A verification email will be sent to the provided address. The account becomes active only after the email is verified. If the verification email does not arrive within a few minutes, check the spam folder or request another verification email.
